name: Footprints
overview: The Scriptures reveal that God created mankind uniquely in His own image, granting them dominion over all creatures on earth, including the fish, birds, and beasts (Genesis 1:26-27; Psalms 8:8). This divine design establishes humanity's distinct role and responsibility in God's creation. Additionally, the presence of mighty beings and notable peoples in early biblical history (Genesis 6:4; Genesis 15:19) highlights the complexity of the world God formed. God's creative power is further demonstrated through His making of great creatures like the behemoth, underscoring His sovereign authority over all life (Job 40:15).
